title: french customs seize 260 million cocaine dunkirk 2026 09 10
text:
PARIS, Sept 10 (Reuters) - French customs officers seized nearly 3.9 metric tons of ​cocaine with an estimated street ‌value of €225 million ($261.45 million) at the northern port of Dunkirk on Thursday, ​the French organized crime ​prosecutor's office said.
($1 = 0.8606 euros)
